text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash taught me that 'Leckermaul' 
is the evil witch from the Brothers Grimm 
fairy tale 'Hansel and Gretel.'

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What if her "friend" was a wicked 
witch...? Manhattan Cafe feels anxious 
about the entity guiding her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy, who noticed the situation, 
told them that "good witches exist too."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Zenno Rob Roy will run in the 
Japan Cup. She, too, is a rival brought 
together by "friend."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What will Manhattan Cafe gain from her 
race with Zenno Rob Roy?
